TitleAustralian National Provider Identifier at an Organisation (NPIO)
Statusactive
Definition

A National Provider Identifier at Organisation (NPIO) uniquely identifies an individual practitioner at an organisation using the practitioner’s HPI-I and organisation’s HPI-O to form the NPIO. Changes to this naming system are managed by the Australian HL7 Affiliate (HL7 Australia).
